title: Technology in your life
instructionsHu: A vizsgáztató arról kérdez, milyen technikai eszközöket használsz, és mit gondolsz a tudományról. Válaszolj több mondatban, és mondj példákat a saját életedből.

questions.q: What electronic devices do you use every day?
followUps: Which one could you not live without?

questions.q: What do you mostly use your phone for?
How many hours a day do you spend in front of a screen?
Do you use computers or tablets at school? What for?
How do your grandparents use technology? Do you help them?
Do you like science subjects at school, for example physics or biology?
Do you watch science programmes or videos? What was the last one about?
What do you do to keep your personal information safe online?
What do you think will be the most important invention of the next twenty years?

usefulPhrases.en: I use my phone for almost everything.
I spend about four hours a day online.
usefulPhrases.hu: Naponta kb. négy órát töltök az interneten.
Soha nem adom meg senkinek a jelszavamat.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What electronic devices do you use every day?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I use my phone and my laptop every day, and I've also got a smartwatch that counts my steps. I use the laptop mainly for homework.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Which one could you not live without?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Probably my phone, because I use it for almost everything: chatting, music and even buying bus tickets.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What do you mostly use your phone for?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Mostly for messaging my friends and listening to music on the way to school. I also practise English vocabulary with an app every evening.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: How do your grandparents use technology? Do you help them?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: My grandma only uses her phone to call us and to look at family photos. Last month I showed her how to send voice messages, and now she sends me one almost every day.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What do you do to keep your personal information safe online?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I use different passwords for my accounts, and my profiles are private, so only my friends can see my photos. I never share my address with people I don't know.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a vizsgázó minden kérdésre kifejtve, saját életéből vett példákkal válaszol (a nagymama hangüzenetei, a szókincstanuló alkalmazás), és a rákérdezésre is indokol.
Szókincs: a technika témakörének mindennapi szavai pontosak (device, smartwatch, counts my steps, voice messages, passwords, my profiles are private).

Nyelvhelyesség: a jelen egyszerű idő a szokásokra, az egyszerű múlt az egyszeri eseményre (Last month I showed her …) helyes, a „that counts my steps” vonatkozó mellékmondat és a „show somebody how to …” szerkezet is hibátlan.
Érdemes megtanulni: „I use it for almost everything”, „on the way to school”, „I showed her how to send voice messages”, „with people I don't know”.
